title: Everything Nature Preserved to Creep Out Doug (Amber and Fossil Marathon)
intro: Nature never throws anything away. Ticks, spiders and flies sit in amber, mammoths sit in ice, monsters sit in stone, and every one of them is still waiting for Doug. Here is everything it kept.
description: Four full episodes back to back: the creepiest things trapped in amber, the most disturbing things nature kept trapped the longest, fossils that still look alive, and what gets scarier the deeper Doug digs. Real science, cartoon deaths.
